newsitem.title: UK: New C&W unit to target wholesale traffic.
newsitem.headline: New C&W unit to target wholesale traffic.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Plc said on Wednesday it formed a new business unit to coordinate the marketing of its global network for wholesale delivery of international traffic.
The unit, called Carrier Services, will target second-tier carriers and operators who carry international traffic from customers but do not have the resources to build their own global networks.

"Wholesale traffic is the fastest growing segment of the market and represents a very exciting opportunity for Cable & Wireless to carry a significantly greater share of the world's international traffic," the company said in a statement.
